1 | """minishop: a tiny FastAPI shop used as a test fixture for the Rook engine.

3 | It ships with four deliberate bugs. `MINISHOP_FIXED=1` (or `create_app(fixed=True)`) fixes all of them:
4 |   1. refunds are checked one at a time, not against the running total
5 |   2. buying checks stock, awaits, then decrements (concurrent buys oversell)
6 |   3. shipping ignores a cancelled order
7 |   4. the admin export only requires a login, not the admin role
8 | 
9 | State is in memory and belongs to one app instance, so every `create_app()` call starts clean.
10 | """

169 |         store.products[product.id] = product
170 |         return {"id": product.id}
171 | 
172 |     @app.get("/products/{product_id}")
173 |     async def read_product(product_id: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
174 |         product = store.products.get(product_id)
175 |         if product is None:
176 |             raise HTTPException(404, "product not found")
177 |         return {"id": product.id, "name": product.name, "price": product.price, "stock": product.stock}

180 |     async def buy(body: NewOrder, user: CurrentUser) -> dict[str, Any]:
181 |         if user.role != "customer":
182 |             raise HTTPException(403, "only customers can buy")
183 |         product = store.products.get(body.product_id)
184 |         if product is None:
185 |             raise HTTPException(404, "product not found")
186 |         if is_fixed:
187 |             async with store.stock_lock:

191 |         else:
192 |             if product.stock < body.quantity:
193 |                 raise HTTPException(409, "out of stock")
194 |             await asyncio.sleep(0.01)  # BUG 2: another buy can pass the check before this one decrements
195 |             product.stock -= body.quantity
196 |         order = Order(
197 |             id=store.new_id(),
198 |             owner_id=user.id,
199 |             product_id=product.id,
200 |             quantity=body.quantity,
201 |             paid=product.price * body.quantity,
202 |         )

232 |         if is_fixed and order.status == "cancelled":
